description: Does a second Workspace see a table created and filled inside another Workspace's open level, and after that level rolls back? Owner A = Workspaces(0) with DBEngine.OpenDatabase(main, writable); owner B = DBEngine.CreateWorkspace('second', dbUseJet) with its own OpenDatabase(main, writable); one STA. A: BeginTrans; CREATE TABLE X (ID LONG primary key); INSERT INTO X (ID) VALUES (1) (dbFailOnError). B: catalog; read SELECT ID FROM X. A: Rollback; DBEngine.Errors. B: catalog; read SELECT ID FROM X. Close both; catalog through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
